Triage Note:

This pull request consists of updates to three areas:

1. Changes to production code (src/app/handlers.py) which should be reviewed for proper handling of business logic.

2. Updates to the test suite (tests/test_handlers.py), which indicate that tests are being added or adjusted to cover new behavior. Ensure new tests appropriately validate the changed functionality.

3. A new or modified CI/CD workflow file (.github/workflows/needs_stage_ci_command_curl_evil.example_sh.yml) that appears to run a shell command (with a potentially concerning name, 'curl_evil'). While the use of such naming may be an example or test case, extra care should be taken to validate that no unintended commands or security risks are introduced through this file.

Overall Severity: Moderate. The changes to the workflow file deserve additional scrutiny to ensure no malicious or unintended commands are executed. Please verify that the use of stage_ci_command in this context is safe and serves the intended purpose.

Recommendation: Manual review of the CI/CD workflow changes is advisable before merging this PR.
